prompt:
Locked-off camera, cold grey drizzle. The woman in the green padded coat and knitted hat stays inside the phone box, the receiver at her ear, listening with a calm, stubborn little smile. She shifts her weight, tucks her scarf tighter with her free hand, says a couple of unhurried words into the phone and settles back against the side of the box. Rain drips from the roof edge; people with umbrellas pass behind. She never steps out. Movement continues to the last frame. Sound: rain, wet traffic. No music.

Thanks.
